cards.name: Blinding Fog
cards.oracleText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to creatures this turn. Creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn. (They can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

cards.name: Fog
cards.oracleText: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.

cards.name: Fog of War
cards.oracleText: You gain 1 life for each creature on the battlefield. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures with power 3 or less.

cards.name: Moonmist
cards.oracleText: Transform all Humans. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures other than Werewolves and Wolves. (Only double-faced cards can be transformed.)
